selectionReason: The next fifteen, in source-row order, of the 271 absent frozen rows at least one of whose KANJIDIC2 readings is used by an existing word article that declares the kanji (an automatic alignment of each word's kana against the kanji's readings), the rule announced on issue 60 after batch 136. A card quizzes each reading that a declaring word article uses, unless the pinned JMdict marks the spelling as ateji or the reading as gikun; name-only readings are never quizzed; a reading type with no such reading gets an empty quizzed list.
